trials.claim: Kortex works inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity to send entire conversations into NotebookLM in one click
trials.claimQuote: Kortex sits inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity and sends your entire conversation into NotebookLM in one click.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the extension completely fails to fetch or create notebooks and that its in-interface features stopped working, directly undercutting the claimed one-click sending into NotebookLM.

exhibits.quote: It completely fails to fetch any of the notebooks or create a new notebook.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the core notebook fetching and creation needed for one-click sending does not work at all.

exhibits.quote: but then my notebooks disappeared, and Chrome extension features, such as accessing my saved prompts directly within the NotebookLM interface, stopped working.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the in-interface extension features stopped working after a day or two.

exhibits.quote: A Send to Notebook button inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and more.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms a Send to Notebook button exists inside all four claimed AI chats.

exhibits.quote: The biggest win for me is how easy it is to grab conversations from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and web pages without the usual copy-paste mess.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms easy grabbing of conversations from ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.

trials.claim: Seller can import entire AI conversations into any notebook in one click
trials.claimQuote: Import entire conversations from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity into any notebook in one click
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports it is unable to add anything to an existing notebook or a new notebook, directly conflicting with importing conversations into any notebook in one click.

exhibits.quote: It's unable to add anything to an existing notebook or to a new notebook.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports it cannot add anything to any existing or new notebook.

exhibits.quote: On the free Basic tier: 10 exports per day, 10 imports per day, 5 source views per day, and 10 saved prompts in total.
exhibits.argument: The vendor limits imports to 10 per day, undermining unlimited one-click import into any notebook.

exhibits.quote: Just click on the NotebookLM button in a chat, and you will be prompted to add the chat to a new project or existing one.
exhibits.argument: This shows a chat can be added to a new or existing notebook with one click.

exhibits.quote: Just one click and all chats imported to NBLM.
exhibits.argument: Buyer quote confirms all chats are imported in just one click.

trials.claim: Users can highlight any webpage text and save it as a cited source
trials.claimQuote: Highlight any text on any webpage and save it as a cited source, making it easy to build a library as you browse
trials.reasoning: The vendor states highlighted passages land as a source with their link, and a buyer confirms highlighting text from any webpage and sending it in works; the formatting and browser exhibits do not materially undercut that.

exhibits.quote: Information imported into ressources looses its data formating then how could you use the
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports imported information loses its formatting, undermining saving as a usable cited source.

exhibits.quote: Kortex currently supports Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based), Brave Browser, and other Chromium-based browsers. Firefox support is coming soon.
exhibits.argument: The vendor limits use to Chromium browsers only, undermining the claim of any webpage.

exhibits.quote: Highlight a passage and right-click, or send the whole page. It lands as a source with its link.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states highlighted passages land as a linked source.

exhibits.quote: Highlighting text from any webpage and sending it straight in feels borderline magical.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms highlighting text from any webpage and sending it in works.
